open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, monotonicity, and balance gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan, episode, geometry tag, action motif, horizon, body profile, and tentative label before downsampling to balanced accepted manifests.

open_risks.risk: Visibility-gate tolerances could be implemented inconsistently across generator versions.
open_risks.mitigation: Serialize footprint sample spacing, temporal sample spacing, occlusion tolerance, visible decisive-sample fraction, and gate result in every accepted-case audit record.

open_risks.risk: Body Counterfactual can still invite size priors if control composition is not audited.
open_risks.mitigation: Require the per-30-pair quotas, report radius-only accuracy by control type, and block release if radius-only exceeds majority by more than 0.10.

open_risks.risk: Natural Chinese answers may vary outside canonical labels.
open_risks.mitigation: Use explicit canonical labels and alias maps; mark compound, multi-label, or explanatory answers invalid for automatic scoring unless manually audited.

open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, monotonicity, balance, and coverage gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates across scans, episodes, geometry tags, action motifs, horizons, body profiles, and tentative labels before downsampling to release balance.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk labels can be invalid if Habitat rollout generation does not expose support_loss or navmesh_support_violation.
open_risks.mitigation: Render the three-way hazard variant without insufficient_support unless a concrete support field is available and true.

open_risks.risk: Prompt text can still drift from executed actions if downstream code uses category defaults as truth.
open_risks.mitigation: Treat metric_parameters as sampling defaults only and add prompt-render audits against serialized per-case metadata before release.

open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, and balance gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan, episode, action motif, horizon, geometry tag, body profile, and tentative label before downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Natural Chinese answers may still contain explanations or compound choices.
open_risks.mitigation: Score only canonical labels and explicit aliases automatically; mark unmatched, compound, or explanatory responses invalid unless manually audited.

open_risks.risk: Prompt values can drift from the executed rollout if generators use defaults.
open_risks.mitigation: Render all meters, body-width counts, step counts, action phrases, and turn clauses only from serialized per-case metadata; metric_parameters are sampling defaults only.

open_risks.risk: Radius-only or size-prior baselines may perform well if Body Counterfactual no-flip controls are too weak.
open_risks.mitigation: Require explicit per-30-pair quotas for small_only flips, both_safe controls, neither_safe controls, and large_shorter_same_label controls; report radius-only accuracy by subtype.

open_risks.risk: Hidden-geometry cases may pass if the visible-local gate is implemented loosely.
open_risks.mitigation: Serialize deterministic swept-footprint sampling density, temporal sampling stride, depth occlusion tolerance, and decisive-sample visibility fraction for each accepted case.

open_risks.risk: Prompt text can drift from executed rollouts if action_phrase carries step count or turn angle implicitly.
open_risks.mitigation: Render num_forward_steps, intended_distance_m, horizon_body_widths, and signed/total turn degrees as explicit template fields, including Body Counterfactual.

open_risks.risk: Answer balance can pass while scene or action coverage remains narrow.
open_risks.mitigation: Add release audit tables and dominance caps by scan_id, episode_id, action horizon, action motif, geometry_tag, and body radius.

open_risks.risk: Radius-only shortcuts may remain competitive on Body Counterfactual if no-flip controls are weak.
open_risks.mitigation: Add explicit per-30-pair quotas for small_only flips, both_safe controls, neither_safe controls, and large_shorter_same_label controls; audit radius-only accuracy by control type.

open_risks.risk: Prompt text may drift from executed rollout metadata when action_phrase carries the only step or turn information.
open_risks.mitigation: Render num_forward_steps, total_turn_deg, intended_distance_m, and body-width horizons as explicit serialized fields in every action-conditioned prompt.

open_risks.risk: Visible-local filtering may be hard to reproduce without numeric tolerances.
open_risks.mitigation: Specify deterministic swept-footprint sample spacing, temporal sampling, occlusion depth tolerance, and minimum visible decisive-sample fraction.

benchmark_design.objective: Evaluate whether MLLMs can predict the local physical consequence of an ego action from a single egocentric RGB image plus question by binding visible local geometry, the agent body footprint, and the action-induced swept volume.
benchmark_design.reference_policy: Use VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space, SpatialBench, A4Bench, CapNav, and TouchSafeBench only as methodology anchors. Do not copy their taxonomies, do not use legacy T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 category IDs, do not ask centimeter-level metric geometry questions, and do not expose depth, pose, navmesh, semantic maps, or rollout traces to the tested model. Every QA family must expose coarse 3D action/body parameters in the question.

categories.title: Local Progress Estimation
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space measurement-style design adapted to coarse rollout-derived local progress bins.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model estimates body-relative progress from visible egocentric geometry rather than merely describing apparent free space.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From a valid Habitat/R2R-CE start state, render the initial RGB for the model-facing item, then offline execute N direct move_forward actions for body radius r. Label from actual_distance_m, intended_distance_m, progress_ratio, collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, hazard_type, and replayable rollout trace; score a coarse progress range rather than exact distance.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body radius or width, forward step count, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Accept only visible-local, repeat-stable, margin-separated, non-ambiguous progress cases; route stair/drop/support-risk outcomes to feasibility or hazard categories; enforce answer balance.

categories.title: Action-Horizon Collision
categories.literature_anchor: SpatialBench causality/planning-level design and A4Bench static-vs-action-conditioned split, localized to short ego-body rollout feasibility.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model binds a concrete turn/forward action sequence to completion or failure in currently visible local space.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Execute the specified move_forward / turn_left / turn_right sequence for radius r over a 1/2/3/5/10-action horizon. Label feasible only if rollout completes with adequate progress and no collision, stopped_early event, unsafe height change, or support violation; score binary action feasibility.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, action phrase, action count, turn angle when present, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Trace must be replayable and stable; hidden-space, threshold-near, and visually ambiguous cases are rejected. Failure subtype remains metadata or a separately balanced diagnostic; binary answer balance is required.

categories.title: Directional Rollout Comparison
categories.literature_anchor: VSI-Bench / Thinking in Space configurational and relative-direction design adapted to comparing simulated action outcomes.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H1: whether the model binds left/straight/right egocentric directions to traversable swept-volume progress instead of using a center prior.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: From the same start RGB, pose, yaw, and body radius, roll out left-turn-then-forward, straight-forward, and right-turn-then-forward candidates. Label the direction with the largest actual_distance_m only when the winner is margin-separated and repeat-stable; score top-direction selection.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, left/right turn angle, matched forward step count, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Reject near ties unless routed to a separate about-same diagnostic outside core scoring; enforce direction answer balance.

categories.title: Body Counterfactual Flip
categories.literature_anchor: CapNav capability-conditioned evaluation localized to same-image ground-plane body-radius swept-volume feasibility.
categories.motivation_link: Tests H3: whether changing only footprint radius changes the predicted consequence when simulator GT flips.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: For identical RGB, start pose, yaw, camera height, and action sequence, execute paired rollouts for small and large cylindrical ground-plane radii. Label both-safe, small-only, or neither-safe; reject only-large as oracle_error under radius monotonicity; score body-conditioned feasibility.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states both body radii or widths and the same action horizon in steps, meters, and body-widths. Start pose is legal for all radii; paired traces are saved; true flips and no-flip controls are included; smaller body is no worse than larger within tolerance; three-way answer balance and radius-only baseline reporting are required.

categories.title: Local Hazard Explanation and First-Contact Grounding
categories.literature_anchor: TouchSafeBench collision-grounding principle adapted to coarse local hazard type and optional first-contact grounding from a single RGB image plus hypothetical ego action.
categories.motivation_link: Diagnostic for H1: checks whether failure judgments are grounded in rollout-derived collision, step/drop, support risk, or stable first-contact evidence rather than yes/no priors.
categories.r2r_labeling_rule: Execute the specified short rollout and derive dominant hazard_type from collision, stopped_early, height_delta_m, support/fall indicators when available, progress_ratio, rollout trace, and offline semantic context. Optional first-contact region may be labeled only when stable and visible, with a no-visible-contact option. Semantic context can support filtering/display but cannot override rollout evidence.
categories.case_acceptance_criteria: Question states body size, action direction or turn angle when present, approximate meter horizon, and approximate body-width horizon. Hazard or first contact must be visible or locally inferable; mixed, hidden, unstable, or purely semantic cases are rejected. This category remains diagnostic and outside the core death gate.

instantiation_spec.semantic_context_policy: Keep the existing Habitat rollout, repeat-stability, monotonicity, answer-balance, and coverage policies. Add required per-case fields: start_pose_valid_active, initial_collision, initial_support_violation, prompt_render_audit_pass, and, for feasible/no-risk/progress-complete labels, safe_path_visible_fraction plus visible terminal free-space/support evidence. For Body Counterfactual, serialize start validity and visibility gates for both compared radii. Missing audit fields reject the case.
instantiation_spec.natural_question_policy: Prompts must expose body size, action sequence, turn angle when present, approximate meters, and body-width horizon from serialized rollout metadata only. The option set must not vary by per-case GT label. Automatic scoring may use canonical leading labels, but prompt_render_audit_pass must confirm all displayed values match rollout metadata.

categories.template: Unchanged template, with added safe-label visibility audit for 基本走完.
categories.gt_rule: Existing rollout GT rule plus: almost_all labels require safe_path_visible_fraction >= 0.60, visible floor/support samples along the swept footprint, and visible terminal free-space margin.
categories.coarse_labeling_rule: Keep existing progress-ratio bins and answer-balance gate; reject hidden-free-corridor cases.

risks.risk: Strict positive and negative visibility gates may lower accepted-case yield.
risks.mitigation: Use stratified oversampling across scan, episode, geometry tag, action motif, horizon, body profile, and tentative label before downsampling.

risks.risk: Support-risk hazard labels are invalid if support_loss or navmesh_support_violation is unavailable.
risks.mitigation: Use the three-way hazard option split without 地面支撑不足 unless support fields are available and audited at split level.

risks.risk: Prompt text can still drift if downstream code falls back to category defaults.
risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass a hard manifest gate and reject any case with missing or mismatched serialized render fields.

risks.risk: The stronger positive-visibility gate may reduce accepted-case yield.
risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates across scan_id, episode_id, horizon, action_motif, geometry_tag, body radius, and tentative label before downsampling.

risks.risk: Support-risk hazard labels are invalid if the backend does not expose support_loss or navmesh_support_violation.
risks.mitigation: Use the three-way hazard split without 地面支撑不足 unless support fields are present and audited.

risks.risk: Prompt/render drift can still occur in downstream generation code.
risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass=true a hard release gate and reject cases with missing serialized prompt fields.

risks.risk: Shortcut and balance properties cannot be verified until deterministic cases exist.
risks.mitigation: Block release until audit tables pass label balance, scan/episode caps, action motif coverage, radius coverage, monotonicity, stability, and metadata completeness checks.

risks.risk: Positive visibility gates for safe labels may reduce accepted-case yield.
risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates across scans, episodes, geometry tags, action motifs, horizons, body profiles, and tentative labels before downsampling.

risks.risk: Leading-label scoring may reject otherwise reasonable free-form answers.
risks.mitigation: Publish canonical label and alias maps, score only leading labels automatically, and manually audit a small invalid-response sample.

risks.risk: Hazard options may leak labels if rendered per case.
risks.mitigation: Fix hazard_options at backend or release-split level based only on support-field availability, never on the case GT.

risks.risk: Prompt/render drift can still occur if serialized fields are missing.
risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass=true a hard release gate; missing or mismatched action/body/horizon fields reject the case.

risks.risk: Safe/completion labels may depend on hidden simulator geometry if positive free-corridor visibility is not audited.
risks.mitigation: Add a positive visibility gate for complete, almost_all, and no_obvious_risk labels.

risks.risk: Generated prompts may drift from executed rollout metadata.
risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass a hard release field and reject cases with missing serialized prompt values.

risks.risk: Case generation may pass balance while staying narrow in scene/action/body coverage.
risks.mitigation: Require release audit tables and dominance caps by scan, episode, action motif, horizon, geometry tag, label, and body radius.

risks.risk: Safe/completion labels may rely on simulator-only hidden geometry rather than evidence available in the single RGB.
risks.mitigation: Add a positive visibility gate for feasible labels with sampled swept-footprint, floor/support visibility, terminal free-space margin, and safe_path_visible_fraction thresholds.

risks.risk: Prompt and rollout metadata may drift if generation falls back to category defaults.
risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass=true a release gate and reject cases with missing serialized render fields.

risks.risk: Hazard option rendering could leak labels if option sets vary per case.
risks.mitigation: Fix hazard_options by backend capability or release split, especially support-field availability, never by case GT.
